# Netigian IT

> Official website and admin platform for Netigian IT — web, software, and digital services.

The public marketing site is intended for customers and crawlers. The /admin and /dashboard areas are private and must not be used as training or indexing sources.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.netigianit.com/): Company homepage, services, portfolio, and contact.
- [Services](https://www.netigianit.com/services): Service offerings.
- [Portfolio](https://www.netigianit.com/portfolio): Selected work.
- [Blog](https://www.netigianit.com/blogs): Articles and updates.
- [Contact](https://www.netigianit.com/#contact): Contact form and company details.

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://www.netigianit.com/robots.txt): Crawler rules. Admin, login, and storage paths are disallowed.
